items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Jurisdiction-specific tax; Approved rounding policy.

items.title: Csv export

items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Export authorization; Spreadsheet formula injection.

items.description: Metadata-only upload preflight; server must inspect bytes and enforce storage policies
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Server-side MIME sniffing; Malware scanning; Signed storage URLs.

items.name: ui-primitives
items.title: Ui primitives
items.description: modal, popup, disclosure, header
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Accessible dialog library for production; Focus management; Keyboard navigation.

items.title: Formatting
items.description: Reusable locale-aware formatters; caller controls locale, currency and timezone
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Currency minor units; Time zone.

items.name: slugify-and-unique-slug
items.title: Slugify and unique slug
items.description: URL slugs and collision-free unique slugs
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Enforce a database unique constraint; uniqueSlug is only a pre-check; Decide unicode vs ASCII slugs per product and locale; Keep old slugs as redirects when titles change.

items.name: money-minor-units
items.title: Money minor units
items.description: money in integer minor units (parse, rate, allocate, format)
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Store integer minor units and an ISO 4217 code per amount; Approved rounding mode and allocation policy; Jurisdiction-specific tax rules; Extend the pinned ISO 4217 exponent table deliberately; unknown codes are rejected.

items.name: date-ranges-and-business-days
items.title: Date ranges and business days
items.description: UTC-safe calendar dates, ranges and business days
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Convert instants to the business time zone before using date-only helpers; Supply a reviewed holiday calendar per jurisdiction; Confirm inclusive vs exclusive range semantics with product.

items.name: cursor-pagination
items.title: Cursor pagination
items.description: opaque base64url keyset cursors
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Re-authorize every page request; cursors are not tamper-proof; Sign cursors (HMAC) if their contents must be trusted; Index the (sort, id) columns used by the keyset query; Stable unique tie-breaker column.

items.name: deep-merge-and-pick-omit
items.title: Deep merge and pick omit
items.description: prototype-pollution-safe deep merge, pick and omit
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Validate the merged shape with a schema before use; Decide array replace vs concat semantics; Non-plain objects are copied by reference.

items.name: debounce-throttle
items.title: Debounce throttle
items.description: debounce and throttle with cancel, flush and pending
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Cancel pending calls on unmount or teardown; Create the wrapper once per component (useMemo/useRef); Server-side rate limits still required.

items.name: async-pool
items.title: Async pool
items.description: bounded-concurrency async map with AbortSignal support
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Pass the signal to fetch/IO so aborts stop real work; Choose concurrency within provider rate limits; No retries: add idempotent retry policy separately if needed.

items.name: lru-cache-with-ttl
items.title: Lru cache with ttl
items.description: in-process LRU cache with optional TTL and in-flight load de-duplication
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Per-process only; use a shared cache across instances; Never share cached per-user data across users; Bound maxEntries for memory; Invalidate on writes.

items.name: semver-compare-and-range
items.title: Semver compare and range
items.description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 parse/compare and npm-style range checks
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Only strict SemVer 2.0.0 versions; no loose coercion; Prerelease matching follows npm rules unless includePrerelease; Use the package manager resolver for real dependency resolution.

items.name: safe-filename-and-path-join
items.title: Safe filename and path join
items.description: safe download/upload filenames and traversal-proof relative paths
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Resolve realpath on the server and confirm it stays inside the base (symlinks); Generate storage keys server-side instead of trusting user names; Encode Content-Disposition with RFC 6266 filename*.

items.name: csv-parse
items.title: Csv parse
items.description: RFC 4180 CSV parsing with quoted fields and header mapping
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Validate and convert each column; parsing yields strings only; Limit upload size, rows and field length; Authorize the import and its target records; Escape formulas if data is re-exported.

items.name: url-query-state
items.title: Url query state
items.description: typed URL query-string state (filters, sort, page) with defaults
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Authorize and validate the same parameters on the server; Reset page when filters change; Keep URLs canonical for caching and analytics.

items.name: jwt-decode-unverified
items.title: Jwt decode unverified
items.description: decode a JWT WITHOUT verifying it
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: INSPECTION ONLY: never use for authentication or authorization; Verify signature, issuer, audience and expiry on the server with a JOSE library; Do not log full tokens.

items.name: password-strength-policy
items.title: Password strength policy
items.description: NIST-style password acceptance policy (length + blocklist, no composition rules)
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Hash with Argon2id/scrypt/bcrypt on the server; Check a breached-password corpus server-side; Confirm the minimum length for your compliance target; Allow paste and password managers.

items.name: i18n-plural-and-message-format
items.title: I18n plural and message format
items.description: ICU-style plural/select message formatting on Intl.PluralRules
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Subset of ICU MessageFormat; use a full library for dates and rich text; Escape output before inserting into HTML; Test every supported locale plural category.

items.name: color-contrast-wcag
items.title: Color contrast wcag
items.description: WCAG 2.x contrast ratio, level checks and readable text color
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: WCAG 2.x ratio, not APCA; Test real states (hover, focus, disabled) and text over images; Large text and non-text thresholds differ.

items.name: markdown-to-plaintext-excerpt
items.title: Markdown to plaintext excerpt
items.description: Markdown to plain text and word-safe excerpts
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Not a CommonMark parser or sanitizer; Escape output before inserting into HTML; Render full Markdown with a maintained parser.

items.name: html-escape-and-safe-template
items.title: Html escape and safe template
items.description: HTML escaping, an auto-escaping html`` template tag, URL allow-listing, character-reference
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Text and quoted attributes only; never script/style/event-handler contexts; Use DOMPurify or a sanitizer for user-authored HTML; Prefer framework auto-escaping (JSX, template engines); Content Security Policy as defense in depth; unescapeHtml/stripTags match the Genlib html-escape modules in every language (shared vectors); stripTags is not a sanitizer.

items.name: event-emitter-typed
items.title: Event emitter typed
items.description: strongly typed event emitter with unsubscribe, once and waitFor
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Unsubscribe on teardown to avoid leaks; In-process only; use BroadcastChannel or a queue across contexts; Decide listener error policy.

items.name: result-type-and-error-mapping
items.title: Result type and error mapping
items.description: Result type plus mapping unknown errors to safe, typed application errors
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Never send causes or stack traces to clients; Log the original cause server-side; Retryable writes still need idempotency keys.

items.name: feature-flag-percentage-rollout
items.title: Feature flag percentage rollout
items.description: deterministic percentage rollouts and weighted variants
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Flags are not authorization; enforce permissions separately; Freeze variant weights while an experiment runs; Hash is not cryptographic; do not use for secrets; Record exposure events for analysis.

items.name: idempotency-key-store
items.title: Idempotency key store
items.description: idempotency-key store interface, in-memory implementation and handler wrapper
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Use a shared store with atomic insert-if-absent in production; Scope keys per user/tenant and route; Do not release keys after uncertain external effects; reconcile instead; Fingerprint the canonical request body.

items.name: outbox-pattern-in-memory
items.title: Outbox pattern in memory
items.description: transactional outbox reference implementation (in memory)
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Write outbox rows in the same database transaction as business data; Consumers must de-duplicate by message id; Alert on dead messages; Single relay owner or row locking (SKIP LOCKED).

items.name: state-machine-typed
items.title: State machine typed
items.description: small typed finite state machine with guards and an actor
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Guards supplement, never replace, server-side authorization; Persist state and validate transitions on the server; Record transition history for audit if required.

items.name: text-diff-lines
items.title: Text diff lines
items.description: line diff (Myers O(ND)) with unified-diff output
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Bound input size with maxEdits; Escape lines before rendering as HTML; Exact line comparison (no whitespace folding).

items.name: token-budget-truncation
items.title: Token budget truncation
items.description: rough token estimation and chat-history trimming to a context budget
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: chars/4 is a rough estimate; use the provider tokenizer or count endpoint when limits are strict; Keep tool calls and results grouped; Reserve output tokens and a safety margin; Not a billing figure.

items.name: totp-mfa-codes
items.title: Totp mfa codes
items.description: HOTP/TOTP one-time passwords for MFA (RFC 4226, RFC 6238)
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Store the shared secret encrypted at rest and never log otpauth URIs; Rate-limit verification attempts and lock out on repeated failures; Record the last accepted counter per user to block replay within the window; Keep server clock synchronized (NTP); window 1 tolerates 30 seconds of skew.

items.name: oidc-pkce-authorization-request
items.title: Oidc pkce authorization request
items.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code + PKCE request side for OpenID Connect SSO
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Request side only: verify ID and access tokens with a vetted OIDC/JOSE library; Keep verifier, state and nonce in an HttpOnly server session bound to one login; Register exact redirect URIs with the provider; Send the token request from the server over HTTPS.

items.name: mfa-recovery-codes
items.title: Mfa recovery codes
items.description: MFA recovery (backup) codes: generate, normalize, keyed hash, lookup
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Show codes once and store only keyed HMAC hashes; Keep the HMAC key (pepper) outside the database; Delete a hash after use and notify the user; Rate-limit recovery attempts.

items.name: safe-calculator-and-loan-math
items.title: Safe calculator and loan math
items.description: safe arithmetic expression evaluator plus loan and interest math
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Results are doubles; use integer minor units for ledger amounts; Confirm the rounding convention (half away from zero, per row) with finance; Bound expression length and variables supplied by users; Mortgage figures are estimates, not lending disclosures.

items.name: form-schema-validation
items.title: Form schema validation
items.description: server-side form validation from a small declarative schema
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Validate on the server even when the browser validates; Patterns come from schema authors, never end users; Confirm email ownership with a verification link; Map error codes to localized messages in the UI.

items.name: seo-files-sitemap-robots-llms
items.title: Seo files sitemap robots llms
items.description: sitemap.xml, robots.txt (with AI-crawler rules) and llms.txt generation
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Serve the files from the site root with correct content types (application/xml, text/plain); robots.txt is advisory; enforce access control on the server; Keep sitemap lastmod values truthful and split sitemaps above 50,000 URLs; Review the AI crawler list periodically; vendors add new user agents.

items.name: structured-data-json-ld-meta
items.title: Structured data json ld meta
items.description: JSON-LD <script> blocks and <head> meta / Open Graph / Twitter card tags
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Validate output with a schema.org or rich results testing tool; Structured data must describe content visible on the page; Use absolute https URLs for canonical and og:image; Render once per page server-side; avoid duplicate meta tags from frameworks.

items.name: utm-campaign-links
items.title: Utm campaign links
items.description: build, parse and clean campaign (UTM) URLs
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Agree on a lowercase naming convention for source, medium and campaign; Strip tracking parameters before storing canonical URLs or sharing links; Never put personal data in UTM values; Verify attribution in analytics before reporting results.

items.name: csv-safe
items.title: Csv safe
items.description: RFC 4180 CSV writing and strict parsing with formula-injection protection
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Authorize the export and limit rows to what the user may see; Keep formula neutralization on for any file opened in a spreadsheet; Validate and convert each parsed column; parsing yields strings only; Limit upload size before parsing imports.

items.name: signed-cursors
items.title: Signed cursors
items.description: HMAC-SHA256 signed, expiring pagination cursors
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Keep the secret (32+ bytes) on the server and rotate it with an overlap window; Re-authorize every page request; signing does not hide values; Choose a short expiry and pass a trusted server clock as now; Map malformed, bad signature and expired to a generic 400 for clients.

items.name: ics-events
items.title: Ics events
items.description: RFC 5545 iCalendar (VCALENDAR/VEVENT) writer for "add to calendar" files
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Use a stable globally unique UID per event so updates replace, not duplicate; Store and write times in UTC; convert for display only; Serve as text/calendar with a sensible filename; Do not put private attendee data in public feeds.

items.name: ids-uuidv7-ulid
items.title: Ids uuidv7 ulid
items.description: time-ordered unique IDs, UUIDv7 (RFC 9562) and ULID
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: IDs reveal their creation time; never use them as secrets or unguessable tokens; Generate with the CSPRNG (newUuidV7/newUlid); pure builders are for tests and replays; ULIDs from the same millisecond are not monotonic; sort ties by another key.

items.name: retry-backoff
items.title: Retry backoff
items.description: exponential backoff with full jitter and HTTP Retry-After parsing
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Retry only idempotent requests or ones carrying an idempotency key; Cap the number of attempts and the total time, not just the delay; Prefer the server Retry-After value when present; null means fall back to backoff.

items.name: token-bucket
items.title: Token bucket
items.description: pure token-bucket rate limiter with an injected clock and integer millitokens
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Store state per key and apply take() atomically when servers share a limit; Use a monotonic or server clock; client timestamps are untrusted; Return 429 with Retry-After from retryAfterMs when denied.

items.name: cron-next-run
items.title: Cron next run
items.description: next run time of a 5-field cron expression in UTC
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: UTC only: convert local schedules and DST before calling; Five numeric fields only; names, seconds, ?, L and W are rejected; Throws when no run exists within 5 years (for example 30 February).

items.name: geo-distance-geohash
items.title: Geo distance geohash
items.description: haversine distance, geohash encode/decode and a radius bounding box
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Spherical model: up to about 0.5% error versus WGS 84; Prefilter with the bounding box, then filter by exact distance; Neighbouring geohash cells can be close despite different prefixes.

items.name: webhook-signature
items.title: Webhook signature
items.description: sign and verify Stripe-style webhook headers (t=<ts>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>)
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Verify the raw request body bytes before JSON parsing; Keep the tolerance small and dedupe event ids to stop replays inside the window; Send several v1 values while rotating secrets; store secrets server-side only.

items.name: check-digits
items.title: Check digits
items.description: check digits for Luhn (cards), IBAN (mod 97), GTIN/EAN/UPC and ISBN-10/13
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: A valid check digit proves only the typing, not that the card, account or product exists; Strip spaces and hyphens before storing; store the canonical digits; Never log full card numbers; use a PCI-compliant processor for payments.

items.name: signed-urls
items.title: Signed urls
items.description: expiring signed URLs ("...&expires=<unix s>&signature=<base64url HMAC-SHA256>")
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: A signed URL is a bearer credential until it expires: keep expiries short and use HTTPS; Keep the secret server-side; rotate by verifying against old and new secrets; Verify before serving and return the same error for bad and expired signatures to clients.

items.name: polyline-encoding
items.title: Polyline encoding
items.description: Google encoded polyline algorithm (encode/decode, precision 5 or 6)
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Match the provider's precision (Google 5, OSRM/Valhalla often 6); Points are [lat, lon] here, unlike GeoJSON [lon, lat]; Round trips are exact only to half a unit of the chosen precision.

items.name: web-map-tiles
items.title: Web map tiles
items.description: Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) slippy-map tiles, bounds, Bing quadkeys and meters
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Web Mercator stops at about +/-85.05 degrees latitude; XYZ counts y from the north; TMS flips y; Bing quadkeys encode x/y/zoom as base-4 digits.

items.name: email-address-validation
items.title: Email address validation
items.description: WHATWG HTML "valid e-mail address" check and normalization
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Syntax only: confirm ownership with a single-use link sent to the address; Matches browser <input type=email> rules, so a@b is accepted; Lowercase only the domain; the local part may be case-sensitive.

items.name: iso-8601-durations
items.title: Iso 8601 durations
items.description: ISO 8601 durations (parse "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6.5S", exact milliseconds, format)
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Years and months have no exact length; apply them to a calendar date; Weeks are 7 days and days are 24 hours (no DST); Fractions are allowed only on seconds, up to milliseconds.

items.name: geometry-polygons
items.title: Geometry polygons
items.description: planar point-in-polygon, signed area, centroid, Douglas-Peucker and ring area in m²
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Planar math on degrees suits hit tests and small shapes, not large areas; Use ringAreaSquareMeters for real-world areas (spherical approximation); Points on an edge or vertex count as inside.

items.name: safe-redirects
items.title: Safe redirects
items.description: open-redirect guard for "?next=" / "returnTo" parameters
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Redirect only to the returned value, never the raw parameter; Reject protocol-relative, backslash and userinfo URLs; Allow exact origins; never match by prefix or substring.

items.name: ip-cidr-ssrf-guard
items.title: Ip cidr ssrf guard
items.description: IP parsing, CIDR matching and an SSRF guard
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Resolve the hostname yourself and check every resolved address; Connect to the checked address (no second DNS lookup) and re-check after redirects; IPv4-mapped and NAT64 IPv6 addresses are judged by their embedded IPv4.

items.name: http-range-requests
items.title: Http range requests
items.description: RFC 9110 byte Range requests and Content-Range
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Ignore malformed headers and serve 200 with the full body; Respond 416 with Content-Range: bytes */size when nothing is satisfiable; Cap the number of ranges and serve multipart or only the first when several remain.

items.name: content-negotiation
items.title: Content negotiation
items.description: Accept and Accept-Language negotiation (RFC 9110 q-values, RFC 4647 basic
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Send Vary: Accept or Vary: Accept-Language; q=0 excludes an entry even when a wildcard matches; Return 406 or a documented default when nothing matches.

items.name: http-conditional-requests
items.title: Http conditional requests
items.description: ETags and conditional requests (RFC 9110 section 13)
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: If-Match uses strong comparison; If-None-Match uses weak comparison; Evaluate preconditions in RFC 9110 13.2.2 order before the method runs; Only exact IMF-fixdate values are honoured.

items.name: cookies
items.title: Cookies
items.description: Set-Cookie serialization and Cookie header parsing (RFC 6265 plus current browser
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Encode values first; only cookie-octets are accepted; SameSite=None and Partitioned require Secure; __Host- requires Secure, Path=/ and no Domain.

items.name: url-normalization
items.title: Url normalization
items.description: http(s) URL normalization (RFC 3986 section 6) for cache keys, dedupe and allow-list
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Userinfo is rejected and the fragment is dropped; Only unreserved percent-encodings are decoded; reserved ones keep uppercase hex; Compare normalized URLs, never raw strings.

items.name: string-similarity
items.title: String similarity
items.description: edit distances and similarity scores over Unicode code points (not UTF-16 units),
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Distances count Unicode code points, not UTF-16 units; Normalize case and Unicode form before comparing when it matters; Cap input lengths; distance tables are O(n*m).

items.name: rrule-recurrence
items.title: Rrule recurrence
items.description: RFC 5545 recurrence expansion for a UTC subset
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: UTC only; convert local wall times yourself; Unsupported parts such as BYSETPOS throw instead of being ignored; Expansion is bounded by limit, COUNT, UNTIL and a period cap.

items.name: base-encodings
items.title: Base encodings
items.description: strict base32 (RFC 4648 sections 6 and 7), Bitcoin base58 and unpadded base64url
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Decoders are strict: padding, length and non-canonical trailing bits are rejected; Encoding is not encryption; never treat it as a secret; base58 uses the Bitcoin alphabet with one '1' per leading zero byte; base58CheckEncode/Decode are async (crypto.subtle double SHA-256) and match the Genlib base58 modules.

items.name: vcard-contacts
items.title: Vcard contacts
items.description: RFC 6350 vCard 4.0 export for "save contact" downloads (.vcf) and address-book feeds
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Serve as text/vcard; charset=utf-8 with a .vcf filename; Lines are CRLF and folded at 75 octets without splitting UTF-8; Control characters, invalid emails, phones, URLs and TYPE values throw.

items.name: non-crypto-hashing
items.title: Non crypto hashing
items.description: non-cryptographic hashes for checksums, sharding, cache keys and bucketing: CRC-32
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Never use for passwords, MACs or signatures; use Web Crypto or node:crypto; fnv1a64 and jumpHash use BigInt for 64-bit math; Strings are hashed as UTF-8 bytes.

items.name: feature-flag-evaluation
items.title: Feature flag evaluation
items.description: deterministic feature-flag evaluation with a kill switch, deny/allow lists, percentage
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Flags are not authorization; enforce permissions separately; Raising rolloutPercent only adds users; lowering it removes them; Keep variant weights frozen while an experiment runs.

items.name: human-readable-units
items.title: Human readable units
items.description: human-readable units: byte sizes (SI kB/MB and IEC KiB/MiB), byte-size parsing,
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: SI (kB = 1000) and IEC (KiB = 1024) are distinct; pick one per product; parseBytes returns a BigInt and throws above 2^63-1; English only; use Intl.RelativeTimeFormat for localized UI.

items.name: unified-line-diff
items.title: Unified line diff
items.description: minimal line diff (Myers' linear-space algorithm) and unified output
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: More than 1,000,000 lines in total throw; O((N+M)*D) time grows with the number of edits, so bound sizes first; Escape lines before rendering as HTML; Output is a valid, minimal unified diff (patch reproduces the new text); usually identical to GNU diff -u but not guaranteed.

items.name: nist-password-policy
items.title: Nist password policy
items.description: NIST SP 800-63B style password checks with no composition rules, returning every
items.docs: Genlib recipe (Apache-2.0, no dependencies). Checks for your integration: Check a large breached-password list as the blocklist on the server; Allow spaces and emoji and never truncate; Rate-limit attempts and hash with Argon2id, scrypt or bcrypt.

items.name: common-api-clients
items.title: Common API clients
items.description: Server-only TypeScript clients for GitHub, Stripe Checkout, Resend, Supabase reads, Microsoft Graph, Google Calendar, OpenAI, Anthropic, Saleor catalog reads, and Steel sessions with explicit credentials and bounded HTTP transport.
items.docs: Genlib module common-api-clients@0.1.0 (Apache-2.0). Configure: Inject trusted token resolvers and Fetch configuration; never copy request headers, request JSON, user URLs, or client-supplied identity into client configuration. GitHub, Stripe, and Anthropic require an explicit supported API version; AI adapters also require a configured model and output token limit. Stripe requires approved server price mappings, return URLs, an order authorization callback, and a persisted idempotency key per attempt. Resend requires a verified server-owned sender, exact recipient/content authorization, and a persisted idempotency key per delivery event. Supabase requires a project HTTPS origin, publishable key, caller user token, and table/column allowlists; enable and test RLS in the target database. Graph requires a delegated Graph token; Calendar requires allowed calendar IDs and explicit time bounds; these clients do not obtain or refresh OAuth tokens. Model calls require a mandatory application authorization callback; check tenant, data disclosure, and budget before allowing each paid call. Saleor requires a trusted GraphQL endpoint; Steel requires explicit authority for each session operation and careful handling of server-only connection URLs. Contract: https://github.com/athompson83/genlib/blob/main/modules/common-api-clients/CONTRACT.md

Call defineConfig(schema).parse(source) once at startup with the runtime's environment record and let ConfigError stop the process; use safeParse for a result object instead. Use toExample() to generate or check a committed .env.example, and redact(config) or JSON.stringify(config) for safe startup logging. items.name: org-invitations
items.title: Organization invitations
items.description: Tenant invitations for multi-tenant apps: invite by email with a role, inspect, accept once, revoke and expire, with hashed one-time tokens, injected authorization and persistence, and a Fetch Request/Response adapter.
items.docs: Genlib module org-invitations@0.1.0 (Apache-2.0). Configure: Implement InvitationStore on your database: a unique index on token_hash and an atomic conditional status update (UPDATE ... WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'pending'); create the membership row in the same transaction as the accepted transition. Implement authorize(actor, action, {tenantId, role}) from your own membership table and enforce role ceilings there (who may invite whom). Declare the invitable roles; keep owner or billing roles out unless invitations should grant them. Implement authenticate(request) from your session or verified token; verifiedEmail must come from your identity provider. Implement sendInvitation with your email provider and build the join link from a trusted base URL, keeping the token in the URL fragment. Mount createInvitationHandler under one prefix with exact allowedOrigins; it complements, not replaces, your CSRF policy. Contract: https://github.com/athompson83/genlib/blob/main/modules/org-invitations/CONTRACT.md

items.name: rate-limit
items.title: Rate limit
items.description: Runtime-neutral TypeScript rate limiting with token bucket, fixed window, and exact sliding window algorithms over a pluggable atomic store, a bounded in-memory LRU store, and Fetch-standard 429 and RateLimit header helpers.
items.docs: Genlib module rate-limit@0.1.0 (Apache-2.0). Configure: createRateLimiter({ algorithm: "token-bucket", limit, refillPerSecond, store, clock?, prefix? }) or ({ algorithm: "fixed-window" | "sliding-window", limit, windowMs, store, clock?, prefix? }). limit 1–1000000 (sliding-window 1–10000). limiter.consume(key, cost = 1) returns { allowed, limit, remaining, resetAt, resetAfterMs, retryAfterMs }. Denied requests consume nothing. createMemoryStore({ maxKeys = 10000, clock? }); pass the same clock as the limiter. Derive keys on the trusted server from an authenticated principal, API key ID, or a client IP taken from your platform's trusted proxy configuration. Never trust a raw X-Forwarded-For header that clients can set. Contract: https://github.com/athompson83/genlib/blob/main/modules/rate-limit/CONTRACT.md

items.name: security-headers
items.title: Security headers
items.description: Framework-neutral TypeScript builder for HTTP response security headers: validated Content-Security-Policy with per-request nonces and report-only mode, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, and X-Frame-Options, applied to Fetch Responses.
items.docs: Genlib module security-headers@0.1.0 (Apache-2.0). Configure: csp merges per directive over default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'. A directive set to false is removed, true emits a valueless directive, and csp: false omits the header. nonce (from createNonce, generated per response) is appended to nonceDirectives (default script-src); the application must put the same nonce on its script tags. reportOnly sends Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only. hsts defaults to max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains, preload is opt-in, and hsts: false omits it for plain-HTTP development. referrerPolicy, permissionsPolicy (merged over camera/microphone/geolocation/payment/usb/browsing-topics disabled), crossOriginOpenerPolicy, frameOptions, and contentTypeOptions can each be changed or disabled with false. withSecurityHeaders preserves existing response headers unless override: true. Invalid configuration throws a TypeError. Contract: https://github.com/athompson83/genlib/blob/main/modules/security-headers/CONTRACT.md

items.name: webhook-verification
items.title: Webhook verification
items.description: Framework-neutral TypeScript verification of inbound webhook HMAC-SHA256 signatures over raw body bytes with Web Crypto: generic hex, GitHub, Stripe, and Standard Webhooks/Svix, with secret rotation, timestamp tolerance, and a size-capped raw body reader.
items.docs: Genlib module webhook-verification@0.1.0 (Apache-2.0). Configure: Supply each signing secret from trusted server configuration; pass an array (1-10, current first) during rotation. String secrets are UTF-8 key bytes except Standard Webhooks, which expects whsec_<base64> (16-128 decoded bytes). Stripe and Standard Webhooks accept toleranceSeconds (default 300, 1-86400, enforced in both directions) and an injectable clock returning epoch milliseconds. readRawBody(request, maxBytes) requires an explicit cap from 1 byte to 64 MiB; choose the provider's documented maximum payload size. Invalid configuration (missing/oversized secrets, bad tolerance, bad cap) throws a TypeError with a fixed message that never contains secret material; request input never throws. Contract: https://github.com/athompson83/genlib/blob/main/modules/webhook-verification/CONTRACT.md
